verdict.summary_en: Delivery note DN-260913-768 dated 09/13/2026 from Boise Semiconductor Inc. to Soony Distribution Center Hamburg against PO 4500318714: 8.500 PCS (read as 8,500) of CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5 in 4 packages, gross weight 76 kg, carrier Alpen Air Cargo GmbH. Signed 'Meyer K.' and stamped RECEIVED 16.09.2026 DC-HAM. No corrections, remarks or discrepancies noted.
observations: Quantity '8.500' with a dot is read as 8,500 pieces (thousands separator); the document does not state the convention, so it could be misread as 8.5 but the unit PCS makes 8,500 the sensible reading.
Document date is in US format (09/13/2026) while the receiving stamp uses the European format (16.09.2026).
Handwritten 'Meyer K.' signature on the Received by line; blue receiving stamp is clear.
Page is slightly skewed; the 'Packages' column header extends past the table border, but this does not affect the values.
